rows.draft: You never notice the stuff I do around here.
rows.gold: absolute + you_blame; belief: sharing invisible work
rows.note: "Never" can make this sound like every time, and the part about what you carry may get lost.

rows.draft: Oh great, you booked the late shift again. Love that for our Friday.
rows.note: The words say the opposite of what you mean, so the disappointment about Friday may not come through.

rows.draft: We need to talk about the weekend thing.
rows.note: This says something needs talking about but not what you want to decide.

rows.draft: I'll be home by seven, can you leave the porch light on?
rows.note: Nothing here is likely to get in the way.

rows.draft: You're so flaky. You said you'd help and then vanished.
rows.note: "Flaky" is about who they are; the part they can answer is that they didn't come when they said.

rows.draft: Wow, thanks for the two-hour heads-up.
rows.note: The thanks reads as its opposite, so the real ask, more notice, stays hidden.

rows.draft: I'm sick of always being the one who rearranges everything.
rows.note: "Sick of" and "always" carry the heat; the point is wanting to share who adjusts.

rows.draft: Send me the details now.
rows.note: This reads as an order; it may land better as a request with the reason.

rows.draft: The library has the room booked from two to four.
rows.note: Nothing here is likely to get in the way.

rows.draft: You always decide for everyone.
rows.note: "Always" and a claim about what they do may be heard as a verdict rather than the plan you want to be asked about.

rows.draft: There's the dinner you cancelled, the gift money, and how you spoke to Dad.
rows.note: Three things arrive at once, so the one that hurt most may get buried.

rows.draft: You talk too much when I'm trying to think.
rows.gold: you_blame + character; lands on: tell me the concrete moment
rows.note: This describes them rather than the moment; they've said a concrete moment is easier to hear.

rows.draft: Fine.
rows.note: One word may leave them guessing what you need tonight.

rows.draft: Your drafts are sloppy and it makes us look bad.
rows.note: "Sloppy" is about the person; naming the dates that were wrong gives them something to act on.

rows.draft: Thank you for listening to Grandad's story again.
rows.note: Nothing here is likely to get in the way.

rows.draft: You've obviously decided my opinion doesn't count.
rows.note: This says what they decided inside; what you know is that the plan was made without you.

rows.draft: Can we sync about the thing at some point?
rows.note: "The thing" and "some point" leave out what you want and when.

rows.draft: Sure, pick the paint without me too, why not.
rows.note: Under the "sure" is wanting a say in the room; the words point the other way.

rows.draft: Good game Sunday. Thanks for the ride.
rows.note: Nothing here is likely to get in the way.

rows.draft: I just feel like I'm too much lately. Anyway.
